title: Brain organoids grafted into cortex-free mice will advance human brain research
title_zh: 将人类大脑类器官移植至无皮层小鼠可推动人脑研究
abstract: Cell-based models of the human cortex transplanted into mice produce neurons that are inaccessible in vitro, and could enable scientists to link brain injury to behaviour.
abstract_zh: 将人类大脑皮层的细胞模型移植到小鼠体内，可产生在体外无法获得的神经元，并有望帮助科学家将脑损伤与行为联系起来。
snippet: Cell-based models of the human cortex transplanted into mice produce neurons that are inaccessible in vitro, and could enable scientists to link brain injury to behaviour.
